title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: THE FISH TANK
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Andre Whitfield, a night-shift package sorter in Reno, Nevada.
He hadn't had a real talk with anyone in two years. Unless you count his microwave.
Then one morning he went out for a fish tank.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: HOLD HIM ANYWAY
segments.author: Charles M. Schulz
lines: His coworker Gloria had told him, get something alive in that apartment.
At the shelter next door, a volunteer named Bea put a dog in his arms. Three legs, one ear. Name of Tuesday.
Charles Schulz said it, she told him.
Happiness is a warm puppy.
Ma'am, this is no puppy. Hold him anyway, she said. Andre signed the papers.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THREE TURNS
segments.quote: A dog teaches a boy fidelity, perseverance, and to turn around three times before lying down.
segments.author: Robert Benchley
lines: At home, Tuesday circled on the couch and fell over. Then he tried again.
Bea's note had a line from the humorist Robert Benchley.
A dog teaches a boy fidelity, perseverance, and to turn around three times before lying down.
So every morning after work, Andre walked him. He saw the sun for the first time in years.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: NO QUESTIONS
segments.quote: Animals are such agreeable friends - they ask no questions, they pass no criticisms.
segments.author: George Eliot
lines: Soon Andre told that dog everything. Even about the sister he never called.
Gloria showed him a line from George Eliot.
Animals are such agreeable friends - they ask no questions, they pass no criticisms.
That's the trouble, she said. People ask.
So he called. They talked for two hours.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: NAPOLEON
segments.quote: To his dog, every man is Napoleon; hence the constant popularity of dogs.
segments.author: Aldous Huxley
lines: Every morning, Tuesday met him like a general home from war.
Lou next door quoted the writer Aldous Huxley.
To his dog, every man is Napoleon; hence the constant popularity of dogs.
Well, Napoleon wouldn't stay on nights because he was shy.
Andre asked his boss for days, and got them.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: YOU TOO
segments.quote: What? You too? I thought I was the only one.
segments.author: C. S. Lewis
lines: Now he stood by the dog park fence, saying nothing.
A woman named Priya walked up with a one-eyed pug. I don't know a soul here, she said.
Andre remembered how C. S. Lewis said friendship starts.
What? You too? I thought I was the only one.
She laughed. By spring, their Saturday club had nine banged-up dogs, and donuts.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE FISH TANK
segments.quote: Dogs are not our whole life, but they make our lives whole.
segments.author: Roger Caras
lines: On his birthday, twenty people filled the courtyard. His sister drove up.
Gloria asked, whatever happened to that fish tank?
Andre held up Bea's mug, with a line from Roger Caras.
Dogs are not our whole life, but they make our lives whole.
Now he helps at the shelter. When a quiet guy walks in, Andre hands him a warm dog. Hold him anyway, he says.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Hold on. Keep turning. Pick up the phone. Ask for more. Say you too. Pass it on.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Hold on to something warm. Keep turning. Pick up the phone. Ask for more. Say you too. Pass it on.
I had a goldfish once. It ignored all my stories.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
